reels.title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective State Space Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: Fits the high-performing 'hardware_efficiency' category. It addresses the fundamental flaw in state space models regarding time, allowing for a brilliant visualization of 'time-stretching' or 'temporal quantization' using a clockwork analogy.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why does your AI 'forget' how fast time passes when it processes long videos?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A metronome that keeps beating perfectly even when the music speed changes.
